title: Northgate Store and Online Orders — Amount of the Late-Change Goodwill Refund
content:
**Which fee.** On a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a reschedule that owes no late-change fee books no late-change fee row, so every late-change fee row on such an order carries an amount above 0.00, and the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00 is the one with the latest date, and where two share that date the one recorded first.

**Amount.** The standard late-change goodwill refund is one quarter (25 percent) of the latest late-change fee with an amount above 0.00, rounded half up to the cent. The late-change goodwill percentage is that standard quarter together with every extra percentage on the order; the latest late-change fee with an amount above 0.00 is multiplied once by that percentage, any flat amount on the order is added, the sum is rounded half up to the cent, and the refund never exceeds that fee less every refund already booked against the order's late-change fees. Every count of calendar days in this computation leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**
- Late-change fee rows of 30.00 on 2 April and 60.00 on 9 April, nothing refunded: the latest row is the 60.00 fee and the refund is 15.00.
- The same rows with 50.00 already refunded against the order's late-change fees: the refund cannot exceed 60.00 less 50.00, so it is 10.00.
